Found 80 items in registries @ssych:

Showing items 1-80 of 80:

- file-tree (registry:ui) - A bundle read as a tree: folders fold open under the pointer or the arrow keys, one highlight glides between rows, and a quiet right-hand column says how much each file holds. [@ssych] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- sidebar (registry:ui) - Collapsible accordion sidebar with icon'd sections, an active rail, and socials. [@ssych] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- macos-dock (registry:ui) - macOS-style magnifying dock — cursor-driven icon springs, click bounce, floor reflections, running-app dots, and a ⌘K command menu. [@ssych] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- browser-window (registry:ui) - Chrome / Safari mock window frame for screenshots and embeds; below 480px of its own width it becomes a phone browser with a status row, one address pill and a bottom toolbar. [@ssych] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- macbook-frame (registry:ui) - Front-facing MacBook mockup — drop a screenshot, gradient, or live UI on the screen. [@ssych] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- card-stack (registry:ui) - Draggable stacked-card carousel — swipe or drag the top card, click to expand into a details modal with a floating dock. [@ssych] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- card-grid (registry:ui) - Responsive grid of project cards with hover-reveal actions and a shared details modal. [@ssych] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- card-list (registry:ui) - Vertical list of horizontal project cards with media, copy, and a shared details modal. [@ssych] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- bento-gallery (registry:ui) - Draggable bento grid of media that expands into a shared lightbox modal with a floating dock switcher. [@ssych] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- cutout-card (registry:ui) - Media card with a scooped-out content tray (concave corners), hover-reveal action button, and gradient overlay. [@ssych] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- accordion (registry:ui) - Expanding accordion rows — each reveals its body, a checklist, and a visual. [@ssych] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- project-card (registry:ui) - Shared cutout project card with blurred-gradient media and a liquid-metal hover ring. [@ssych] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- historical-eps (registry:ui) - Forecast-vs-reported quarterly bars — dashed forecasts, a derived Beat-by tip, and a surprise tooltip. [@ssych] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- price-target-fan (registry:ui) - Analyst targets: history draws to now, dashed projections fan to High / Mean / Low, the nearest projection owns the pointer and the hot one draws solid, with a scrub card and a live ring on the now dot. [@ssych] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- market-watchlist (registry:ui) - Sortable quote register — trend sparklines, signed day changes, accent spine on the selected row. [@ssych] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- sma-chart (registry:ui) - Moving-average chart — price line with fast/slow SMA overlays, crosshair scrubbing with a three-series tooltip, and a signed change chip. [@ssych] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- dotted-area-chart (registry:ui) - A price line standing on a field of dots that fades toward the floor. Scrubbing splits the chart at the cursor, lighting the stretch already passed and dropping the rest back, with a read-out carrying the bar's price and its move from the open. [@ssych] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- health-gauge (registry:ui) - A bounded single-metric dial: a 270° arc on one flat track, a value arc that draws in behind an end marker, and a centre number that counts up to it. Clicking the dial cycles the metric and the arc redraws. [@ssych] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- market-heatmap (registry:ui) - The market as one block of ground: tiles sized by market cap on a hand-rolled squarified treemap, tinted on a diverging scale by the day's move. Hovering a tile parks a read-out beside it with price, change and cap; clicking pins it. [@ssych] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- sankey-flow (registry:ui) - A fund-flow diagram where income pools in one hub and fans out into uses, node and ribbon thickness standing for amount. Flow is conserved through the middle, so every outbound strand carries its source's hue across. [@ssych] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- donut-chart (registry:ui) - Allocation as a ring rather than a pie: the stroke is a band around an open centre that the total sits in. Slices sort descending, ring and legend cross-highlight, and square caps keep the gaps between slices real. [@ssych] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- balance-header (registry:ui) - A wallet's headline number with its cents stepped back so the eye lands on the dollars, the move carried in a tinted pill beneath, and a privacy toggle that masks every figure to dots. [@ssych] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- market-snapshot (registry:ui) - Price snapshot card — animated headline price, period-sliced line chart with crosshair scrubbing, and a gliding period switcher. [@ssych] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- index-card (registry:ui) - Markets sidebar card — one big price over a full-bleed scrubbable line, a tab underline that walks between indices, and the one-paragraph read below. [@ssych] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- range-navigator (registry:ui) - Focus + context price history — a detail chart over a mini-map you drag to pan and pull to zoom, with a hover crosshair reading price and date. [@ssych] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- sectors-donut (registry:ui) - Allocation ring with legend cross-highlight — hovering isolates one weight at a time. [@ssych] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- ratings-radar (registry:ui) - Analyst-ratings pentagon with hairline rings and one green wedge toward the dominant rating. [@ssych] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- analyst-radar (registry:ui) - Two-series factor radar — subject filled against a dashed peer outline, a hovered spoke reading both values, and a legend that mutes a series. [@ssych] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- kpi-card-row (registry:ui) - Dashboard stat band — count-up headlines with signed deltas over full-bleed area charts you can hover to read any sample with its date. [@ssych] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- heat-calendar (registry:ui) - Weeks of activity as a sequential single-hue grid with month labels, a gliding date-and-count tooltip, a ripple on hover, click-to-span totals and a legend that filters by level. [@ssych] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- returns-calendar (registry:ui) - Monthly-returns heat grid: years by months diverging up/down by magnitude, a compounded year column, a gliding tooltip that dims everything unrelated, a year replay on hover, and click-to-span compounding by months or whole years. [@ssych] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- holdings-table (registry:ui) - Fund-holdings register with YTD pills and tick-comb weight bars. [@ssych] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- trade-journal-table (registry:ui) - A trade log where the open position is lit from its spine and every closed one settles into a win or loss pill; heads sort, the range thumb slides, net P&L carries its fee formula. [@ssych] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- fills-blotter (registry:ui) - A streaming order-fills table: new fills slide in at the top as working, then resolve in place to filled or rejected; hover a row for venue, order id and fee; pausable. [@ssych] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- candlestick (registry:ui) - Candles over a volume histogram with a magnet crosshair, a price badge on the right axis, a live OHLC legend and a switch to a plain close line. [@ssych] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- equity-drawdown (registry:ui) - A cumulative equity curve over a synced underwater drawdown panel; one crosshair reads equity, drawdown and days below the high-water mark. [@ssych] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- balance-chart (registry:ui) - Wallet-value area chart: trend picks the colour, the high and low float at their true points, scrubbing greys everything ahead of the cursor, and timeframe pills reseed the walk. [@ssych] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- price-scrubber (registry:ui) - Scrub chart with a magnet crosshair, price and time badges on the axes, a hero number that recolours off the reference price, a wash under the pointer and timeframe pills. [@ssych] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- comb-rows (registry:ui) - A comparison as rulers of ticks: the cursor tick stands taller at the value and the subject row carries the accent; hover hands it to another row. [@ssych] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- ticker-tape (registry:ui) - A finance tape gliding through a hairline rail on a seamless loop; hovering holds it still, moves read green up and red down. [@ssych] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- trade-tape (registry:ui) - Live time and sales: prints stream in side-coloured and sized by a magnitude bar, block trades tint the row, and hovering pauses the tape. [@ssych] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- simple-chart (registry:ui) - The compact asset-price card: one line, one number that scrubs under the pointer, and a signed-percent tag the line is de-trended to agree with. [@ssych] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- matrix-ticker-board (registry:ui) - A retro dot-matrix price wall on canvas: 5×7 dot glyphs, and on each quote update only the changed characters dissolve out dot by dot and bloom back. [@ssych] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- request-log (registry:ui) - API log rows with status pills that unfold their response body inline. [@ssych] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- new-items-pill (registry:ui) - A live tape that pins the row you are reading — arrivals stop pushing the list down and count into a pill until you tap back to the top. [@ssych] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- inbox (registry:ui) - Notification inbox — unread dots dissolve on read, mark-all clears the column. [@ssych] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- project-index (registry:ui) - Bare project rows where the cover only exists while you hover, floating beside the cursor. [@ssych] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- news-card (registry:ui) - Auto-cycling news module with an ink headline and dot pagination. [@ssych] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- alert-stack (registry:ui) - Collapsed notification deck that fans open on hover; each dismiss re-settles the pile. [@ssych] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- assets-balance-card (registry:ui) - Deep-ground balance hero: rolling odometer digits, an ambient signal line, scrub readout, and a drag handle that pulls the chart taller. [@ssych] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- onboarding-checklist (registry:ui) - Setup checklist — the check draws in and the progress bar keeps a derivable score. [@ssych] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- preferences-card (registry:ui) - Settings rows with icon tiles, one-line hints, and a chevron that walks in on hover. [@ssych] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- empty-state (registry:ui) - A dotted field, a hairline icon chip, one line of ink and one quiet action. [@ssych] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- swap-ticket (registry:ui) - Composed trade card. A flip button on the seam really swaps the cards, a token-select overlay covers the ticket, and the CTA label is the validation state. [@ssych] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- segmented-control (registry:ui) - Hairline pill whose thumb glides between options with a shared-layout spring. [@ssych] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- avatar-stack (registry:ui) - Overlapping gradient-orb coins with a surface ring. Hovering lifts and names a coin, and the overflow count floats the hidden names without widening the stack. [@ssych] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- amount (registry:ui) - Money-formatting family — Fiat, Crypto and Percent agree on symbol placement, precision, abbreviation and sign colouring. [@ssych] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- crypto-fiat (registry:ui) - Dual-denomination amount field. Type in fiat or units, the toggle carries the value through the rate, and the headline steps down a size tier as it grows. [@ssych] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- screen-shuffle (registry:ui) - Stacked screens where the front card arcs to the back on a timer or click. [@ssych] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- mouse-trail-cta (registry:ui) - CTA stage where the cursor's particle trail gravitates into the pill and feeds its glow. [@ssych] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- ascii-turntable (registry:ui) - An extruded solid that turns with the cursor and is redrawn as characters on a grid. The lighting is graded for the ramp, so the face lands mid-scale instead of saturating to one glyph. [@ssych] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- metal-badge (registry:ui) - Any SVG mark as a domed chrome badge, drawn in WebGPU. It leans toward the cursor with the light following, and a click flips it. Falls back to a flat chrome face where WebGPU is missing. [@ssych] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- stone-badge (registry:ui) - Any SVG mark as a carved stone badge, drawn in WebGPU: facets, fissures and mineral speckle on a roughened dome. It leans toward the cursor with the key light following, and a click flips it. Falls back to a flat stone face where WebGPU is missing. [@ssych] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- gold-badge (registry:ui) - The metal badge in gold: any SVG mark as a domed, brushed gold badge drawn in WebGPU. It leans toward the cursor with the light following, and a click flips it. [@ssych] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- holo-badge (registry:ui) - Any SVG mark as a holographic badge: a silver dome under a thin film whose colour shifts with the angle, with a fine sparkle. Drawn in WebGPU, it leans toward the cursor and flips on click. [@ssych] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- glass-badge (registry:ui) - Any SVG mark as a frosted glass badge: translucent, with the light catching its rolled edge and the page showing through. Drawn in WebGPU, it leans toward the cursor and flips on click. [@ssych] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- neon-badge (registry:ui) - Any SVG mark as a dark badge with a neon outline that glows and breathes. Drawn in WebGPU, it leans toward the cursor and flips on click. [@ssych] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- lightning-badge (registry:ui) - Any SVG mark as a dark glass badge with lightning crawling over its face. Drawn in WebGPU, it leans toward the cursor and flips on click. [@ssych] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- ascii-badge (registry:ui) - Any SVG mark as a domed badge drawn in characters: the lit surface is read per cell and each cell's brightness picks a character from the ramp, so the letters change with the light as it turns. Drawn in WebGPU, it leans toward the cursor and flips on click. [@ssych] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- portfolio-book (registry:block) - The balance-first book on one ruled grid: holdings, history and share-of-total composed from six library components, with the page composing and never editing them. [@ssych] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- portfolio-allocation (registry:block) - Composition first. Leads with what the book is made of and how concentrated it is, which is the analyst's first question rather than the owner's. [@ssych] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- portfolio-tiers (registry:block) - The book as four accounts rather than one balance. One pill per tier under the bar, and the pill row is a selector rather than decoration, carrying share-of-total on the tier. [@ssych] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- discover-board (registry:block) - The browsing problem, not the reporting one: filters and a trending rail for finding something you do not already hold. [@ssych] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- discover-screener (registry:block) - The screener take on discovery: a dense sortable board where the row is the unit and the filters carry the state. [@ssych] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- terminal-cex (registry:block) - An exchange terminal on one ruled workspace: candle chart under an interval bar, book or tape as tabs, ticket and account on the right, and a full-width positions register at the fold. [@ssych] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- gpu-pods (registry:block) - A GPU rental marketplace's browse screen: 150 pods in a 15-column table you can sort, search and cross-read, with a filter rail whose counts are honest and a product rail of its own. White on black, no accent hue. [@ssych] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- ascii-scroll-morph (registry:block) - An immersive landing page with live 3D ASCII shapes that respond to the cursor and transition as you scroll. Adapt the vector artwork, copy and colours in code to fit your brand, while keeping the motion system intact. [@ssych] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- tradeboard-landing (registry:block) - A product landing built on one rule: one ground, one subject, one accent. Giant display headline, the product UI as the hero image, then metric cards, a bento container grid and a three-step band. [@ssych] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- stablecoin-landing (registry:block) - A token landing on the same structure: hero with a brand marquee, a three-card product explainer, a backers marquee and a use-modes grid. Everything structural is shared with the Tradeboard page, so the two stay one system. [@ssych] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- simple-landing (registry:block) - The library's own marketing page: a near-black ground, one object per section, two-tone display type carrying the hierarchy, and every count read live from the registry. [@ssych] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`
